items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: There was a clarinetist there, Jack -- not Jack Butler. ... Yeah, his name was Butler, but he kept playing. He played a doggone nice clarinet. In fact, the teacher came in one day, we were teaching the -- I was teaching to trumpet, and he was showing me the clarinet

ctx.x: You know if any of them, except you, became professionals?
Aw, I don't think so. I don't think so. No, not of the Calhoun band, no. No. There was a clarinetist there, Jack -- not Jack Butler. Hmmm.
